annotations.title: Check for anti-dumping duty on Chinese goods

description: Use when the user asks whether extra anti-dumping or countervailing duty applies to goods from China: checks whether a UK measure applies on a commodity code, from the live UK Trade Tariff. Deliberately gives no rate, because it depends on the exporter.

commodity_code.description: A 6 to 10 digit UK commodity code.

locale.description: Language for names and links: en (default) or zh (Simplified Chinese).

name: check_anti_dumping
title: Check for anti-dumping duty on Chinese goods
